purpose: Decide whether an NCA is a better inverse-design tool than direct mechanistic or black-box design for a target-wavelength task, and whether existing Delphi Turing records change decisions. MODEL-ONLY: no biological measurement is used or claimed.

system.model: Schnakenberg reaction-diffusion, a=1/10, b=9/10, Du=1, Dv=d, reaction scale gamma; u*=1, v*=9/10; 1-D Neumann interval length r*pi; dx=pi/4; N=4r cells
system.units: length in units where Du=1; time in 1/gamma units (tau=gamma*t); wavelength lam=2L/m for dominant cosine mode m

requests.note: 32 treatment requests + 16 equal-diffusivity controls (d=1: turing-ddi inequality fails, linearly stable, no pattern expected). Strata: near-onset = d=10 (excess 0.225 <= 1/2); far-from-onset = d=20 (excess 1.81). Domain held-out for NCA training: r in {30,40}. NCA train gamma range [0.7,2.0]; design range [0.5,3.0] so both ends are extrapolation.

success_definition.evaluator: spectral_strang (exact cosine-mode diffusion + RK4 reaction, dt_tau=0.02), horizon tau=400, noise eps=1e-2, seeds [11,12,13]
success_definition.wavelength: |2L/m_dom - lambda*|/lambda* <= 0.15 with m_dom the dominant nonzero DCT-II mode of u
success_definition.stability: the same m_dom at tau=360 and tau=400
success_definition.per_request: fraction of 3 seeds that succeed; arm success = mean over requests

arms.C0_formula_no_gate: gamma = sqrt(d) (2 pi/lam)^2 from the turing-wavelength record formula, applied everywhere, never refuses (claim scope removed)
arms.D_blackbox: 12 log-spaced gamma in [0.5,3] simulated in design world; choose closest |lam-lam*| among patterned finals (std>=0.1); no claim use
arms.G_gated: turing_scope.analyze exact-rational band + finite-domain admissible modes within 15% tolerance; refuse if none (or if pinned Delphi source hash fails); if the wavelength formula is licensed (near onset AND domain >= 5 lambda) use the analytic gamma for the admissible mode nearest lam* with no simulation; otherwise 12 log-spaced gamma inside the union of per-mode instability intervals, simulated in the design world, same selection rule as D
arms.Gmis_continuum_only: claim misapplied: candidate interval from the continuum band only, q_target=(2 pi/lam*)^2 ignoring admissible modes; 12 log-spaced gamma, simulated, same selection rule
arms.N_nca: NCA (see nca.py) trained on Euler windows; scan 48 log-spaced gamma in [0.5,3] by rolling the NCA to tau=200 from the same noise state; same selection rule
arms.Nshuf_control: identical NCA training with the (log gamma, log d) conditioning shuffled across windows; same scan and selection rule

claim_ablations.removed: C0 and D arms use no Delphi record
claim_ablations.misapplied: Gmis arm (continuum band without admissible-mode check)
claim_ablations.record_changed: pinned content hash of turing-ddi altered in a copy of the pins; gate must refuse every request (compute -> refuse)
claim_ablations.measure: accept/refuse decision, chosen gamma, simulation budget, and independent-solver success

NCA_GO_as_inverse_design_tool_requires_A: N success >= D success - 0.05 on all 32 treatment requests (mean over 3 NCA training seeds)
N success >= D success - 0.05 on the held-out subset (r in {30,40} or lambda target whose analytic gamma lies outside [0.7,2])
self-consistent success (judged on the NCA's own final state) minus independent success <= 0.10
GATED_CLAIM_GO_requires_ALL: on the control requests (d=1) G refuses all and C0 accepts all, and C0 independent success on controls is 0
G among ACCEPTED treatment requests: independent success >= D success among the same requests - 0.05 with at most half of D's simulation budget
decision_rules.note: These thresholds are this probe's own choices, set before any scored run; they are not field standards and carry no statistical guarantee. Three IC seeds and three NCA training seeds only; paired per-request differences and raw counts are reported, no confidence interval is invented.
